title: The Ox and the Frog
moral: A frog is wonderful as a frog, and an ox is wonderful as an ox.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본. text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, trim 은 from 줄의 영어 녹음을 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.cut:<monster|pop|fly|splash|jump>: 그림 컷 5장 — 컷 속 외침(VOICE_LINES cut_pop·ox_thud)은 그대로 재사용

lines.text: 연못에 아침이 왔어요. 아기 개구리들이 아직 쿨쿨 자고 있네요.
lines.en: Morning came to the pond. The baby frogs are still fast asleep, zzz.
segs: Morning came to the pond. The baby frogs are still fast asleep, zzz.

lines.text: 햇살이 반짝, 연잎 위에 이슬이 또르르 굴러요.
lines.en: The sunlight sparkles, and dewdrops roll across the lily pads, roly-poly.
segs: The sunlight sparkles, and dewdrops roll across the lily pads, roly-poly.

lines.text: 아기 개구리들이 기지개를 쭉, 눈을 깜빡깜빡 떴어요.
lines.en: The baby frogs stretched, s-t-r-e-t-c-h, and blinked their eyes open, blink, blink.
segs: The baby frogs stretched, s-t-r-e-t-c-h, and blinked their eyes open, blink, blink.

lines.text: 엄마개구리가 말했어요. "얘들아, 멀리 가면 안 된다~"
lines.en: Mama Frog said. "Children, don't go far away~"

lines.text: 하지만 아기 개구리들은 폴짝폴짝, 몰래 연못을 빠져나갔어요.
lines.en: But the baby frogs went hop, hop, hop, and sneaked right out of the pond.
segs: But the baby frogs went hop, hop, hop, and sneaked right out of the pond.

lines.text: 아기 개구리들이 몰래 풀밭으로 나왔어요.
lines.from: 아기 개구리들이 몰래 풀밭으로 나왔어요. 톡 눌러서 폴짝폴짝 가 볼까요?
lines.en: The baby frogs sneaked out to the meadow.
segs: The baby frogs sneaked out to the meadow.

lines.text: 풀잎이 살랑살랑, 아기 개구리들은 신이 나서 폴짝폴짝 뛰었어요.
lines.en: The grass swayed gently, swish, swish, and the baby frogs hopped about happily, hop, hop.
segs: The grass swayed gently, swish, swish, and the baby frogs hopped about happily, hop, hop.

lines.text: 어? 눈앞에 커다란 무언가가 있어요!
lines.en: Oh? Something huge is right in front of us!
segs: Oh? Something huge is right in front of us!

lines.text: 아기 개구리들은 눈을 동그랗게 뜨고 멈춰 섰어요.
lines.en: The baby frogs stopped still, their eyes as round as marbles.
segs: The baby frogs stopped still, their eyes as round as marbles.

lines.text: 이건 뭘까요? 꼬리일까요, 나무일까요?
lines.en: What could this be? A tail or a tree?
segs: What could this be? A tail or a tree?

lines.text: 길쭉한 것이 살랑살랑 흔들려요. 꼬리였어요!
lines.en: Something long was swishing back and forth, swish, swish. It was a tail!
segs: Something long was swishing back and forth, swish, swish. It was a tail!

lines.text: 이번엔 뭘까요? 발굽일까요, 돌멩이일까요?
lines.en: What is it this time? A hoof or a pebble?
segs: What is it this time? A hoof or a pebble?

lines.text: 쿵, 쿵! 땅을 울리는 커다란 발굽이었어요.
lines.en: Thump, thump! It was a great big hoof that shook the ground.
segs: Thump, thump! It was a great big hoof that shook the ground.

lines.text: 이건 뭘까요? 뿔일까요, 나뭇가지일까요?
lines.en: What could this be? A horn or a branch?
segs: What could this be? A horn or a branch?

lines.text: 뾰족한 것이 삐죽! 머리 위에 솟은 뿔이었어요.
lines.en: Something pointy stuck straight up, poke! It was a horn on top of a head.
segs: Something pointy stuck straight up, poke! It was a horn on top of a head.

lines.text: 커다란 황소였어요! 아기 개구리들은 깜짝 놀라 도망쳤어요.
lines.en: It was a big, big ox! The baby frogs were so startled, they ran away.
segs: It was a big, big ox! The baby frogs were so startled, they ran away.

lines.text: 아기 개구리들은 헐레벌떡 연못으로 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: The baby frogs came rushing back to the pond, huffing and puffing.
segs: The baby frogs came rushing back to the pond, huffing and puffing.

lines.text: "엄마! 산처럼 커다란 괴물을 봤어요!"
lines.en: "Mama! I saw a monster as big as a mountain!"
segs: Mama! I saw a monster as big as a mountain!

lines.text: 아기 개구리들은 부들부들, 아직도 다리가 후들거렸어요.
lines.en: The baby frogs trembled and shook, their little legs still wobbling.
segs: The baby frogs trembled and shook, their little legs still wobbling.

lines.text: 엄마개구리가 말했어요. "흥, 얼마나 컸는데?"
lines.en: Mama Frog said. "Hmph, how big was it?"

lines.text: 개구리보다 오리가, 오리보다 양이, 양보다 황소가 훨씬 커요.
lines.en: A duck is bigger than a frog, a sheep is bigger than a duck, and an ox is much, much bigger than a sheep.
segs: A duck is bigger than a frog, a sheep is bigger than a duck, and an ox is much, much bigger than a sheep.

lines.text: "흥, 나도 황소만큼 클 수 있어!" 엄마개구리가 숨을 크게 들이마셨어요.
lines.en: "I can be as big as an ox!" Mama Frog took a deep breath.
segs: I can be as big as an ox!
Mama Frog took a deep breath.

lines.text: 후우, 후우! 엄마개구리 배가 볼록볼록, 점점 커졌어요.
lines.en: Puff, puff! Mama Frog's tummy bulged and swelled, bigger and bigger.
segs: Puff, puff! Mama Frog's tummy bulged and swelled, bigger and bigger.

lines.text: "아직 황소가 더 커요!"
lines.en: "The ox is still bigger!"

lines.text: 엄마개구리는 또 후우! 숨을 들이마셨어요. 배가 빵빵!
lines.en: Mama Frog took another big breath, pu-u-uff! Her tummy went tight as a drum!
segs: Mama Frog took another big breath, pu-u-uff! Her tummy went tight as a drum!

lines.text: "와, 양만큼 커졌다! 그래도 황소가 더 커요!"
lines.en: "Wow, as big as a sheep! But the ox is still bigger!"
segs: Wow, as big as a sheep! But the ox is still bigger!

lines.text: 엄마개구리가 부들부들 떨려요.
lines.from: 엄마개구리가 부들부들 떨려요. 어어… 한 번 더 누르면 어떻게 될까?
lines.en: Mama Frog is trembling and wobbling.
segs: Mama Frog is trembling and wobbling.

lines.text: 펑! 바람이 푸슈슈 빠지면서 엄마개구리가 하늘로 붕 떠올랐어요.
lines.en: Pop! The air came rushing out, fsss, and Mama Frog shot up into the sky, whoosh!
segs: Pop! The air came rushing out, fsss, and Mama Frog shot up into the sky, whoosh!

lines.text: 푸슈슈슉~ 엄마개구리가 풍선처럼 날아다녀요!
lines.from: 푸슈슈슉~ 엄마개구리가 풍선처럼 날아다녀요! 톡 눌러서 잡아 줘요!
lines.en: Fshhhhh~ Mama Frog is flying around like a balloon!
segs: Fshhhhh~ Mama Frog is flying around like a balloon!

lines.text: 빙글빙글, 휘리릭! 그러다 퐁당! 연못에 떨어졌어요.
lines.en: Round and round, whirl, whirl! And then, splash! Down she fell into the pond.
segs: Round and round, whirl, whirl! And then, splash! Down she fell into the pond.

lines.text: 엄마개구리는 원래 크기로 돌아왔어요. 어지러워도 깔깔깔 웃었답니다.
lines.en: Mama Frog was back to her normal size. Dizzy as she was, she laughed ha ha ha.
segs: Mama Frog was back to her normal size. Dizzy as she was, she laughed ha ha ha.

lines.text: 황소가 몸을 낮추고 다정하게 말했어요. "크지 않아도 괜찮아. 너는 폴짝 뛰기 선수잖아!"
lines.en: The ox bent down low and said kindly. "It's okay not to be big. You're a hopping champion!"
segs: The ox bent down low and said kindly.
It's okay not to be big. You're a hopping champion!

lines.text: 엄마개구리가 폴짝! 풀밭을 가로질러 멀리멀리 뛰었어요.
lines.en: Mama Frog went hop! and sailed far, far across the meadow.
segs: Mama Frog went hop! and sailed far, far across the meadow.

lines.text: 황소도 따라 뛰어 볼까요? 하나, 둘…
lines.en: Shall the ox try hopping too? One, two...
segs: Shall the ox try hopping too? One, two...

lines.text: 쿵! 황소는 폴짝 뛰지 못했어요.
lines.from: 쿵! 황소는 폴짝 뛰지 못했어요. 누가 더 멀리 뛸까요? 개구리!
lines.en: Thud! The ox couldn't hop.

lines.text: 아기 개구리들이 깔깔깔, 엄마개구리도 히히 웃었어요.
lines.en: The baby frogs giggled, tee-hee-hee, and Mama Frog chuckled too.
segs: The baby frogs giggled, tee-hee-hee, and Mama Frog chuckled too.

lines.text: 밤이 되었어요. 나비넥타이를 맨 삼촌 개구리가 놀러 왔어요. 개구리 가족이 노래를 불러요.
lines.from: 밤이 되었어요. 나비넥타이를 맨 삼촌 개구리가 놀러 왔어요. 개구리 가족이 노래를 불러요. 먼저 들어 봐요!
lines.en: Night came. Uncle Frog, wearing a bow tie, came to visit. The frog family sings a song.
segs: Night came. Uncle Frog, wearing a bow tie, came to visit. The frog family sings a song.

lines.text: 개굴개굴, 개굴개굴! 반짝이는 별 아래 노랫소리가 울려 퍼졌어요.
lines.en: Ribbit, ribbit! Ribbit, ribbit! Under the twinkling stars, their song rang out across the pond.
segs: Ribbit, ribbit! Ribbit, ribbit! Under the twinkling stars, their song rang out across the pond.

lines.text: 개굴개굴~ 노래가 잦아들고, 개구리 가족은 쿨쿨 잠이 들었답니다.
lines.en: Ribbit, ribbit~ The song faded away, and the frog family fell fast asleep.
segs: Ribbit, ribbit~ The song faded away, and the frog family fell fast asleep.

lines.text: 개구리는 개구리대로, 황소는 황소대로 멋지답니다.
lines.en: A frog is wonderful as a frog, and an ox is wonderful as an ox.
segs: A frog is wonderful as a frog, and an ox is wonderful as an ox.
